name: PM-USP Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students (CSSS)
description: Ministry of Education merit scholarship for students from low-income families who scored above the 80th percentile in their stream in Class 12 and study a regular degree course.
benefit_text: ₹12,000 per year for the first three years of graduation and ₹20,000 per year at postgraduate level. B.Tech/B.E. students get ₹20,000 only in the 4th year.
check_also: NSP lists this scheme for renewal applications only for 2026-27, so first-year students may not be able to apply fresh. Needs a Class 12 score above the 80th percentile of your board and stream, a regular (not distance or diploma) course, and no other merit scholarship, state scholarship or fee waiver.
documents_needed: Proof of admission in a recognised college
Bank account in the student's own name
how_to_apply: Apply online on the National Scholarship Portal (NSP). Your college verifies the form, then your State higher-education department. To renew you need at least 50% marks in the annual exam and 75% attendance.

name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship Scheme for Girl Students (Technical Degree)
description: AICTE scholarship for girls in the first year of a technical degree, or the second year through lateral entry, at an AICTE-approved institution. Selection is by merit on Class 12 marks.
benefit_text: ₹50,000 per year for up to 4 years (3 years for lateral entry), paid as a lump sum for fees, books, laptop and similar costs.
check_also: Only for first-year (or lateral-entry second-year) students in an AICTE-approved institution. Maximum two girl children per family. The gap between passing Class 12 and joining should not be more than two years, and you must not receive any other scholarship or stipend.
documents_needed: Income certificate issued by State/UT Government
Proof of admission in an AICTE-approved institute
how_to_apply: Apply on NSP once AICTE opens the window. Your institute verifies the form, then your state's technical education department. Selection is state-wise by merit.

name: Central Sector Scholarship of Top Class Education for SC Students
description: For SC students admitted to a full-time course at a top institution notified by the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, such as IITs, NITs, IIITs, IIMs, AIIMS and National Law Universities. Each institute has a fixed number of slots.
benefit_text: Full tuition and non-refundable fees (up to ₹2 lakh per year at private institutes) plus an academic allowance of ₹86,000 in the first year and ₹41,000 in later years.
check_also: Fresh awards go only to first-year students admitted to a notified institute, ranked by entrance exam (30% of slots are reserved for girls). Maximum two siblings per family, and no other similar scholarship.
how_to_apply: Apply on NSP. Your institute checks eligibility and verifies the application within its slot limit.

name: PM YASASVI Top Class Education in College for OBC, EBC and DNT Students
description: Scholarship for OBC, EBC and DNT students admitted to full-time courses at top institutions notified by the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment.
benefit_text: Full tuition and non-refundable fees (up to ₹2 lakh per year at private institutes), ₹3,000 per month living expenses, ₹5,000 per year for books, and up to ₹45,000 once for a laptop.
check_also: Needs admission to a notified top institute, chosen by entrance rank (30% of slots for girls). Maximum two siblings per family. You must apply again every year, even to renew. EBC and DNT students are also covered, but this form only has an OBC option.
how_to_apply: Apply on NSP. Your institute verifies the application within its slot limit.

name: Telangana ePASS Post-Matric Scholarship (RTF & MTF)
description: Telangana government scheme for Telangana-domiciled SC, ST and BC students studying after Class 10. It pays the college fee (RTF) and a monthly maintenance allowance (MTF) and is applied for on the ePASS portal.
benefit_text: Tuition fee reimbursement (RTF) paid to the college, plus a monthly maintenance allowance (MTF) that depends on the course group.
check_also: Income limits differ by category (SC and ST around ₹2-2.5 lakh, BC lower). ₹2 lakh is used here as a cautious cut-off, so confirm your exact limit on ePASS. About 75% attendance is needed, and students admitted under management quota are generally not eligible for fee reimbursement. The last date is announced on the portal.
how_to_apply: Register on the Telangana ePASS portal, then your college verifies the application.

name: Mukhyamantri Yuva Swavalamban Yojana (MYSY) - Gujarat
description: Merit-cum-means scholarship of Gujarat giving financial support for higher education to meritorious students from all categories.
benefit_text: 50% of tuition fees, with caps depending on the course (higher for medical, lower for engineering/pharmacy and degree courses), plus hostel and book grants.
check_also: Reported to need 80 or more percentile in the last qualifying exam. Check the exact fee caps, rules and last date on the official portal.
how_to_apply: Apply online on the official MYSY portal.

name: Swami Vivekananda Merit-cum-Means (SVMCM) Scholarship - West Bengal
description: Merit-cum-means scholarship by the Department of Higher Education, Government of West Bengal, for students at state-aided institutions.
benefit_text: Monthly financial support paid via Direct Benefit Transfer. The amount depends on the course level.
check_also: Needs a minimum percentage in the last qualifying exam, and you cannot hold another government scholarship for the same course. Check the exact marks rule, amounts and last date on the official portal.
how_to_apply: Apply online on the official SVMCM portal.

name: UP Post-Matric Scholarship (General, OBC, Minority)
description: Uttar Pradesh scheme offering financial aid and fee reimbursement to students from Class 11 through postgraduate level.
benefit_text: Maintenance allowance and fee reimbursement. The amount depends on the course and whether you live in a hostel.
check_also: You generally cannot receive both a UP scholarship and an NSP scholarship in the same year. Check the exact rules, amounts and last date on the official portal.
how_to_apply: Apply through the UP scholarship portal during its application window.

name: UP Post-Matric Scholarship (SC / ST)
description: Uttar Pradesh scheme offering financial aid and fee reimbursement to SC and ST students for higher education.
benefit_text: Maintenance allowance and fee reimbursement paid via Direct Benefit Transfer. The amount depends on the course.
check_also: A valid caste certificate is mandatory. Check the exact income limit, amounts and last date on the official portal.
how_to_apply: Apply through the UP scholarship portal during its application window.

name: Rajarshi Chhatrapati Shahu Maharaj Shikshan Shulkh Shishyavrutti Yojna (EBC) - Maharashtra
description: Maharashtra scholarship giving partial tuition and exam fee concessions to economically weaker students in higher education.
benefit_text: Partial tuition and exam fee reimbursement for professional courses in approved institutions.
check_also: Needs Maharashtra domicile and admission through the centralised admission process. Check the exact rules, family limits and last date on the official portal.

name: Karnataka State Scholarship Portal (SSP) Post-Matric Scholarship
description: Post-matric scholarship for students domiciled in Karnataka, combining schemes from the Social Welfare, Tribal Welfare and Backward Classes departments.
benefit_text: Full or partial college fee reimbursement along with a monthly maintenance stipend for eligible students.
check_also: Income limits differ by category and your Aadhaar must be linked to your bank account. Check your exact limit, amounts and last date on the official portal.
how_to_apply: Create an account on the Karnataka SSP portal and link your college.
